config.text: Change only the two faces. The silver lamb in the middle: close its snarling mouth, remove the teeth and the frown, give it a calm half-closed eye. The white salmon's head at the top: close its jaws, remove the teeth, give it a calm round eye. Each face gets a calm, neutral, impassive expression, like a heraldic animal: mouth closed, no teeth, no fangs, no tongue, relaxed brow, a simple calm eye.  Keep everything else exactly identical: the composition, every pose and gesture, the bodies, wool, fins, spots and cut lines, the drawing style and line weight, the white foil and silver foil areas, the burgundy card, the linen background, the framing and the light.
